summary: Tested the new image-generation + publisher-brand feature end-to-end (backend + frontend). Backend: added /app/backend/tests/test_image_feature.py (10 tests) covering publisher_brand='गाजियाबाद टाइम्स' on rewritten/published items, image_url/image_status fields present, source field still kept in DB/API, media serving (200 image/jpeg), path-traversal rejection (400/404), POST /api/news/{id}/generate-image returning 400 on Pending_Review items and 404 on unknown ids, and ONE real Nano Banana generation on a rewritten item without image (image_status→generated, /api/media/*.jpg served 200). Full regression: 26/26 pytest tests pass. Frontend: dashboard loads, Rewritten_Pending_Publish cards hide the real source and show BRAND with shield icon (5 brand occurrences, 0 on Pending_Review tab), cards with image_url render news-image-{id} (naturalWidth=1365 confirmed), cards without image render generate-image-btn-{id} ('फोटो जेनरेट करें'), Pending_Review cards still display स्रोत: label (108 occurrences). Comparison modal opens, displays comparison-image with visible 'गाजियाबाद टाइम्स' watermark + BRAND byline, publish button present. Only 1 real image generation triggered (cost control honored).

issues: Display font appears to not render all Devanagari matras cleanly (looks slightly garbled in header). The body font-hindi class renders perfectly; issue is isolated to the font-display class used on the top header title.

action_items: (Optional) Consider switching the display-font used by the main header 'संपादकीय न्यूज़रूम' to a Devanagari-aware display font (e.g. Noto Serif Devanagari / Rozha One) — the current font causes matras to render imperfectly in that header only.

(Optional, minor) Seed data for SEED_REWRITTEN/SEED_PUBLISHED sets image_status default='none'. Policy for freshly rewritten items without a source photo sets 'awaiting_approval'. Not a bug (seed is pre-feature) but for consistency the startup seed could set image_status='awaiting_approval' on those seeded rewritten/published items.
critical_code_review_comments: image_service._api_key() correctly re-reads EMERGENT_LLM_KEY at call time — the earlier import-time-None bug is fixed.
GET /api/media/{name} path traversal filter checks for '/', '\\', '..' before touching the filesystem — safe; verified with ..%2f.., ..%2Fetc%2Fpasswd, foo%2Fbar.jpg all returning 400/404.
Rewrite endpoint auto-generates image when image_source_url is present and sets image_status='awaiting_approval' otherwise — correctly matches the stated policy.
Frontend MEDIA(it.image_url) prefixes REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL so images load via the public ingress; no hardcoded localhost — good.

Original 'source' field remains in the DB and is returned by GET /api/news (confirmed in test) but NewsDashboard.jsx hides it for non-Pending_Review cards via `it.status === 'Pending_Review' ? source : BRAND` — spec met.

Minor: generate-image-btn is defined once in the card and once inside ComparisonModal with the same data-testid. React duplicate testids are tolerated but could cause strict mode warnings; consider suffixing e.g. '-modal'.
test_credentials: N/A (no auth). WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET from backend/.env used in cron tests.
seed_data_creation: No new seed. Reused existing rewritten/published items. Triggered exactly ONE real Nano Banana image generation on an existing no-image rewritten item (cost control honored).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Image feature is fully covered by /app/backend/tests/test_image_feature.py. If re-running, note test_generate_image_on_rewritten_item_once will consume one Nano Banana call per no-image rewritten item in the DB (it picks the first one found and will no-op/skip if all rewritten items already have images). test_fetch_and_cron.py requires REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var exported before pytest (no default).
rca of the issue: No issues found. The previously reported load_dotenv/EMERGENT_LLM_KEY-at-import bug is confirmed fixed (image_service._api_key() reads env at call time).
